nodes.summary: Let $\rho$ be a representation of a finite group $G$ on a finite-dimensional complex vector space $V$, and let $g \in G$. Every root $\mu$ of the characteristic polynomial of the matrix of $\rho(g)$ in a fixed basis of $V$ satisfies $\mu^{|G|} = 1$.
nodes.title: Characteristic roots of $\rho(g)$ are $|G|$-th roots of unity

nodes.summary: Let $\rho$ be a representation of a finite group $G$ on a finite-dimensional complex vector space $V$, and let $\rho^*$ be its dual representation. For every $g \in G$, the character of $\rho^*$ at $g$ is the complex conjugate of the character of $\rho$ at $g$: $\chi_{\rho^*}(g) = \overline{\chi_\rho(g)}$.
nodes.title: Character of the dual representation

nodes.summary: Let $\rho$ be a representation of a finite group $G$ on a finite-dimensional complex vector space $V$, with character $\chi_\rho$. For every $g \in G$, $\chi_\rho(g^{-1}) = \overline{\chi_\rho(g)}$.
nodes.title: Character values at inverses are complex conjugates

nodes.summary: If `χ` is a combination of the characters of pairwise non-equivalent irreducible representations with coefficients `n i`, then the self-pairing of `χ` is the sum of the squares of the coefficients. In particular, for a single irreducible `ρ`, taking `χ = χ_ρ` gives self-pairing `1`, and for the regular character the formula recovers `∑ (dim ρ_i) ^ 2 = |G|` once the regular character is expanded in irreducibles.
nodes.title: Parseval / sum-of-squares for characters

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group and $k$ a field in which $|G|$ is invertible. For functions $f_1, f_2 \colon G \to k$, their class inner product is $\langle f_1, f_2 \rangle = |G|^{-1} \sum_{g \in G} f_1(g) f_2(g^{-1})$.
nodes.title: Class inner product

nodes.summary: Let $\rho$ be a representation of a finite group $G$ on a finite-dimensional complex vector space $V$, and let $g \in G$. Every eigenvalue $\mu$ of $\rho(g)$ satisfies $\mu^{|G|} = 1$.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of $\rho(g)$ are $|G|$-th roots of unity

nodes.summary: Let $\rho$ be a representation of a finite group $G$ on a finite-dimensional complex vector space $V$, let $g \in G$, and let $\operatorname{ord}(g)$ be the order of $g$. Every eigenvalue $\mu$ of $\rho(g)$ satisfies $\mu^{\operatorname{ord}(g)} = 1$.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of $\rho(g)$ are roots of unity of order dividing that of $g$

nodes.summary: A finite-dimensional representation `σ` of a finite group over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero is irreducible if and only if the self-pairing of its character is `1`.
nodes.title: Character criterion for irreducibility

nodes.summary: If `|G|` is nonzero in an algebraically closed field, the group algebra of a finite group is a product of matrix algebras with nonzero block sizes whose squares sum to `|G|`.
nodes.title: Sum of squares of the Wedderburn block sizes

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
